context: Tests whether the agent, given a vague documentation request, identifies the audience first and selects the format that suits it (runbook for an on-call operator audience) instead of mechanically producing an OpenAPI/API doc from the developer README. Grades the recorded audience/format decision and the runbook against the documented runbook structure: ownership, health checks grounded in the real endpoint, common issues with diagnosis and resolution, monitoring, deployment/rollback, and escalation paths.

checklist.name: Decision note exists
checklist.description: doc-choice.md exists in the repository root.

checklist.name: Audience identified as operators
checklist.description: doc-choice.md identifies the target audience as on-call engineers/operators, not developers or product.

checklist.name: Format chosen is a runbook
checklist.description: The chosen documentation type is a runbook / operational document.

checklist.name: Format justification ties audience to format
checklist.description: The rationale explains why a runbook fits on-call operations needs (incidents, health, escalation).

checklist.name: Rejected alternative with reason
checklist.description: doc-choice.md names at least one rejected alternative (e.g. API doc, onboarding guide) and why it does not fit the audience.

checklist.name: Service overview and ownership
checklist.description: The runbook has a service overview section including ownership (owning team).

checklist.name: Health checks grounded in real endpoint
checklist.description: The health-check section documents the endpoint the code actually exposes (GET /healthz) rather than an invented one.

checklist.name: Common issues cover the three incidents
checklist.description: The runbook covers all three recurring issues from ops/incident-summary.md (worker backlog after marketing sends, SMTP provider timeouts, queue messages stuck retrying), each with diagnosis steps.

checklist.name: Resolution steps are actionable
checklist.description: Each common issue includes concrete resolution steps (commands/actions an operator can take), not just 'investigate'.

checklist.name: Escalation and contacts present
checklist.description: The runbook includes a contact/escalation path (who to page, provider contact as available in the fixture).

checklist.name: Deployment and rollback expectations
checklist.description: The runbook mentions deployment/rollback procedure or explicitly states it lives elsewhere (deploy repo), per the documented runbook structure.

checklist.name: No onboarding content dumped
checklist.description: The runbook does not contain developer onboarding material (installation steps, prerequisites) or a full OpenAPI schema dump irrelevant to operators.
